sentences.text: Otogornis is an extinct genus of enantiornithean birds, a group within the class Reptilia.
The genus was described by Hou in 1994, with the type species Otogornis genghisi found in the Jingchuan Formation of Inner Mongolia.
Only one fossil occurrence of this species has ever been recorded.
This animal lived during the Barremian stage of the Early Cretaceous epoch, between 125.77 and 121.4 million years ago.
